visit.title: Visit
visit.intro: Thinking of coming this Sunday? Here is what to know.
visit.expectBody: Come as you are. Sunday worship starts at 10:00 AM in the main sanctuary: welcome, Scripture, prayer, and fellowship. Stay after for greetings if you want. No pressure.
visit.parkingBody: Park at 15 Alpha Road, Chelmsford, MA 01824 and come in through the main entrance. [PLACEHOLDER] Door and accessibility notes — confirm with church.
visit.kidsBody: Children's worship meets during the Sunday service. Ages, times, and rooms are on the Generations page.
visit.contactBody: [PLACEHOLDER] Email and phone are not listed yet. Ask someone after worship, or reach us on the Facebook page linked in the footer.
